        Idea:
Implement a full ArtAgents architecture/onboarding/source-tree cleanup end to end. Canonical public concepts should be orchestrators, executors, and elements. Treat conductors as aliases/backward-compatible terms for orchestrators in docs, CLI discoverability, and command dispatch. Treat performers and instruments as aliases/backward-compatible terms for executors in docs, CLI discoverability, and command dispatch. Preserve VibeComfy as an external executor/performer/instrument, not an orchestrator/conductor. Add a first-class user-editable elements/primitives domain for render/custom elements with schema/registry/discovery/CLI/install/sync/fork/inspect/list/update behavior where appropriate. Bundle default elements in this repo initially and install/sync them by default; design the model so external git/package/catalog defaults can be supported later without storing executable code in a DB. Make defaults fork-on-edit into workspace/theme overrides. Scan multiple roots with priority active theme > user workspace overrides > installed packages > bundled/default managed elements. Add dependency installation/update support for newly created/used custom elements, including JS package deps and Python requirements where declared, without silently mutating global environments. Do not enforce internal structure inside external executors: VibeComfy and future executors may have their own internal workflows/nodes/prompts; ArtAgents should require only a manifest/API boundary for exposing elements/metadata. Keep existing performer/executor install behavior intact where backcompat requires it. Add clear onboarding: README's agent instructions should be improved and used, add AGENTS.md or equivalent concise entry point if appropriate, add/implement pipeline.py doctor and setup if feasible, and make it obvious what an agent/user should do first. Default orchestrators/conductors and default executors/performers/instruments should appear by default and be clearly documented. VibeComfy and future tools should appear by default; include VibeComfy-associated nodes/workflows/prompts from structured metadata/skill docs where feasible, but avoid brittle free-text scraping as the only source. Include a real source-tree cleanup: audit scattered top-level ArtAgents modules such as event_talks.py, cut.py, publish_youtube.py, quality_zones.py, reigh_data.py, video_understand.py, visual_understand.py, audio_understand.py, scene_describe.py, quote_scout.py, transcribe.py, render_remotion.py, and related bin launchers; classify each as orchestrator, executor, element support, or shared library; move ArtAgents-owned executors into a logical executor/performer folder structure with per-executor metadata/skill/context where useful; simplify or remove the confusing curated-folder distinction if a per-executor folder model is clearer; keep backward-compatible wrappers for existing imports and bin commands; add tests for moved modules and default executor/orchestrator discovery. Add focused tests and run relevant tests. Respect existing dirty working-tree changes in artagents/performers/curated/moirae/SKILL.md and artagents/performers/curated/vibecomfy/SKILL.md; do not revert unrelated user edits.
